column1: # The VM engine is QEMU, built as an in-process iOS library, JIT-accelerated
# exactly like Husk does it (TCG with a debugger-granted split-W^X region).
# The ROM host dlopens the dylib at runtime (LindChain/Phone/NXPMOSEngine);
# this ROM does NOT vendor the engine build itself yet, so bots/CI validate
# the host image and guest-image pipeline, and the engine milestone lands on
# Husk — the iOS Android emulator whose JIT substrate + display-bridge design
# the engine borrows (X/W^X allocator, DisplayChangeListener -> Metal blit,
# UTM's QEMU fork used by Husk — built with -Dshared_lib=true so it can live
# XZ decoder vendored in rom/src/xz (public domain / 0BSD), the on-device
# decompressor for the .img.xz guest image. Already vendored at this pin.
